svg.title: Right-click menu
svg.desc: Two Callout Studio right-click menus in Obsidian. On a block callout: Copy callout Markdown, Set callout closed, Make callout non-collapsible, Edit callout settings and Open Callout Studio settings. On a heading callout: Cut, Copy and Delete heading section, plus the same two settings actions.
